verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents built-in AI features that rename requests, generate structured request payloads, and write pre-request scripts and test cases automatically (docs-35, docs-23). These are task-specific helpers, not a general assistant you can hand open-ended tasks to. The MCP server exposes workspace data to external agents rather than providing an in-product assistant, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: a general conversational or agentic in-product assistant that can take on multi-step tasks, details on scope, limits and availability of the AI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
